title: Configuration and run-launch control center
summary: The UI configures semantic Koni resources and launches a provisional run with all stages and per-run overrides visible.

assertions.description: Configuration is organized by semantic domains and hides redundant run-type persona rows and raw YAML plumbing.
New Run shows all stages, recent target branches, questions, max parallelism, and individually selectable model/reasoning for every persona.
Starting closes the modal and synchronously inserts one provisional run row before planning worker acknowledgement.
